summary: The page layout and component structure are properly aligned for mobile viewports, but several core text elements suffer from severe dark-theme contrast failures that render content illegible.

issues.title: Illegible low-contrast text in dark theme
issues.description: Primary headings, empty-state body copy, and draft list item titles use dark foreground tokens on a dark background.
issues.evidence: 'Archive search', 'No documents match this search', and draft titles like 'Vendor Agreement' blend into the dark surface.
issues.suggestion: Apply light/muted foreground color tokens suitable for dark theme.
